title: Newer versions of your images
explain: Compares the version of each image a container runs with the one its registry offers now. Nothing is downloaded. To apply an update, redeploy the project (the Schedule tab can do it every night, pulling the images).
none: No image in use to follow yet. Check now to look.
logins.title: Private registries
logins.explain: For images in a private registry, save a login here (a password or an access token with pull rights). It is stored encrypted, never shown again, and sent only to that registry and its own token service, to ask which version it offers.
checkTip: Compares each image's tag with the registry's. Nothing is downloaded.
logins.forgetConfirm: Forget the saved login for {{host}}? Private images there can no longer be checked.
